recipes.title: Turkey taco skillet
recipes.summary: 93% ground turkey browned with onion, bell pepper, black beans, and salsa. Serve with corn tortillas, avocado, and lime.
steps: Dice onion and pepper. Drain and rinse beans. Warm tortillas in a dry skillet at the end.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high with a little oil. Add turkey, onion, and pepper. Break up the turkey and cook 8-10 minutes until browned and no longer pink.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, salt, drained beans, and salsa. Simmer 3-4 minutes until heated through.
Plate into tortillas. Top with sliced avocado, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Tomato garlic chicken skillet
recipes.summary: Boneless chicken thighs seared then finished in a quick garlic and cherry tomato pan sauce over whole-wheat pasta with basil and Parmesan.
steps: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package directions. Slice chicken into strips and halve the tomatoes.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high with a little olive oil. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Sear until browned and cooked through, about 6 minutes. Remove to a plate.
In the same skillet, cook minced garlic for 30 seconds, then add tomatoes. Cook until they soften and burst, about 4 minutes. Add a splash of pasta water if needed.
Return chicken to the pan with drained pasta. Toss to coat. Tear basil over the top and grate Parmesan.

recipes.title: Soy-ginger shrimp stir-fry
recipes.summary: Her plate: EZ-peel shrimp stir-fried with broccoli, bell pepper, soy, and ginger over jasmine rice. App swaps chicken onto his plate with the same sides.
steps: Pat shrimp dry if needed. Cut broccoli into florets and pepper into strips. Mince garlic and ginger. Start the rice pouch.
Heat a large skillet over high heat with a little oil. Cook broccoli and pepper 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender. Push to the side.
Add garlic and ginger for 20 seconds. Add shrimp in a single layer and cook 1-2 minutes per side until just opaque and pink.
Splash with soy sauce, toss everything together, and scatter sliced green onions. Serve over rice.

sources.label: Simply Recipes Easy Shrimp Stir Fry

recipes.title: Sheet-pan salmon with green beans and tomatoes
recipes.summary: Her plate: Atlantic salmon roasted with green beans, cherry tomatoes, garlic, and lemon. App swaps chicken onto his plate with the same sides.
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss green beans and halved tomatoes with olive oil, smashed garlic, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan.
Roast the vegetables for 8 minutes. Push them to the sides of the pan.
Season the salmon with salt, pepper, and a little oil. Place in the center. Roast 10-12 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.
Squeeze lemon over the plates before serving.

sources.label: The Kitchn End-of-Summer Sheet Pan Salmon
